newsitem.title: ITALY: Alitalia suspended limit up,KLM link talk.
newsitem.headline: Alitalia suspended limit up,KLM link talk.

text.p: Stock in Italian state airline Alitalia was suspended limit up in Milan, continuing a recent rally on market hopes of a link with Dutch carrier KLM.
"Limited liquidity often creates these situations and it's a very speculative stock, but it's being boosted by expectations of an alliance with KLM," one dealer said.
KLM on Friday confirmed it was in talks with Alitalia on a possible alliance but played down reports they were at an advanced stage.

Alitalia A stock was suspended at a theoretical price of around 990 lire against an 896.9 lire close, the preference share was suspended at a theoretical price of around 670 lire against 590, while the savings share, with a theoretical price of 2,050 lire against 1,175 lire, did not open.
